faq: Is there a lock-in period?
No. There is no lock-in. You can cancel at the end of the current month.
Is {pMonthly} the full price?

Yes, that is the full price of the subscription, excl. VAT. There is only one subscription and no extra charge per enquiry. Only if you use more than 300 minutes a month (inbound and outbound together) does each additional minute cost {pExtraMinute} inbound and {pMinute} outbound, and outbound calls after the package also cost {pCallAnswered}/{pCallVoicemail}/{pCallNoAnswer} per call by outcome.
Can I try it before I buy?
Yes. Dialogbot calls you and handles you as if you were a customer – it takes two minutes and no sign-up. And there's no lock-in.
What happens to my customers' data?
It's explained in a short, plain-language text on our GDPR and data page: what is stored, where, and how the data processing agreement works.
What do outbound campaign calls cost?

Inside the subscription's {pIncluded} minutes (shared with inbound calls) there is no charge per call. Once the package is used up, an outbound call that starts after that costs {pCallAnswered} if the person answers, {pCallVoicemail} at a voicemail and {pCallNoAnswer} when unanswered or busy – plus {pMinute} per started minute of conversation, excl. VAT. At most {pContactMax} per contact. Contacts must have agreed in advance to be called, and a campaign only calls once you press Start yourself.
What if we get a lot of inbound calls?

{pIncluded} minutes a month are included in the subscription – for both inbound and outbound calls, with no charge per call inside them. Beyond that each started inbound minute costs {pExtraMinute}; outbound calls cost {pCallAnswered}/{pCallVoicemail}/{pCallNoAnswer} by outcome plus {pMinute} per minute, excl. VAT. They appear as separate lines on the invoice, and you can follow usage per call in Dialogbot.
Does setup cost anything?

Not if you do it yourself: the build guide's three steps are included in the subscription and take about half an hour. Setup by our specialists costs {pSetup} excl. VAT, paid once, and gives you a tailored setup and integration with your own systems and needs.

what.title: What is an AI receptionist?
what.p1: An AI receptionist is a digital assistant that handles the phone and the chat for your business. It greets the customer, works out what they need, answers the common questions and collects name, number and request, so you can call back a warm lead.
what.p2: With Dialogbot, you decide what the assistant may say. All knowledge starts as a draft and is only used once an owner or administrator has approved it. The assistant never guesses – if something isn't covered by your knowledge, it says so honestly and promises that a member of staff will get back to the customer.

based on your opening hours and booking rules – and send the customer an SMS confirmation.
Answer in the chat
on your website with the same knowledge as on the phone.
Follow up
on quotes you have sent, and give you a daily report of all enquiries.

The tradesperson doesn't have to answer the phone from a ladder, the clinic takes pressure off reception in the morning rush, the salon can stay with the customer in the chair, and the restaurant doesn't lose table bookings at peak times.

Calls and messages are processed by us as a data processor on your behalf, the database is located in the EU, and you get a data processing agreement as part of the terms. Read it all in plain language on our GDPR and data page: /gdpr.

haandvaerkere.title: AI receptionist for tradespeople – answer the phone from the ladder
haandvaerkere.description: Dialogbot answers the phone for the plumber, the electrician, the carpenter and the painter when your hands are full. It collects the job details and address and books site visits.
haandvaerkere.pain: The boss is up a ladder or under a sink and can't answer the phone. Every missed call is typically a customer who calls the next tradesperson on Google instead.
scenario: Hi, I have a leaking toilet – could you come and take a look?
We can certainly do that. What's the address, and is it urgent?

Thank you. I've noted it down, and the boss will call you today to arrange a time.
benefits: Answers the phone when your hands are full

objection: My customers want to talk to me.

faq: Can Dialogbot quote a price for a job?
Only if you have entered and approved the price, e.g. a fixed price per m². Otherwise it notes the job and promises that the boss will get back with a quote.
Can it book site visits?
Yes, based on your opening hours and booking rules – and it always asks the customer for permission first.

join.intro: Do you know a tradesperson, a hairdresser or a clinic that misses calls? Show them Dialogbot. If they become a customer, you get a starting bonus and an ongoing share – and they get {discount} off their first month.
join.earnTitle: How you earn · one subscribing customer
join.firstMonth: First month: {rate} of {amount} (the customer gets 50 % off)
join.tenCustomers: With 10 customers, that's {amount} in the first year. Amounts are before tax; the share is calculated on what the customer actually pays excl. VAT – including campaign calls.

steps.title: Three steps – and you're up and running
steps.recommendText: Answer four quick questions about the rules, and share your personal link or code with businesses you know. If you're under 18, a parent approves by email.
steps.customerText: The business signs up via your link and gets {discount} off the first month. You see the company name and status – never their conversations.
steps.payoutText: {bonus} once the customer has paid their first invoice, plus {rate} of what they pay for {months} months. Paid out to your bank account.

rules.title: How it works
rules.earned: You only earn once the customer has paid. The amount shows as "earned" for {days} days and then becomes available for payout.
rules.payoutMin: We pay out to your bank account once you have at least {amount} available.
rules.tax: Without a CVR number, the bonus is B-income: we report it to the Danish Tax Agency (Skattestyrelsen) with your CPR number, and you pay the tax yourself via your preliminary income assessment. We don't withhold tax.
rules.cvr: If you have a CVR number, you get a settlement statement instead (with VAT if you are VAT-registered).
rules.age: You must be at least {age} years old. If you're under 18, a parent must approve the agreement before we pay out – you can still bring in customers in the meantime.
rules.privacy: You see your customers' company name, status and your bonus – never their conversations or customer data.

signup.title: Become an ambassador
signup.loginFirst: First create a free account (or log in). You'll come straight back here afterwards.
signup.verifyFirst: Confirm your email first – we've sent a link to {email}.

faq.title: What ambassadors ask
faq.whenA: When your customer has paid their first invoice, you get {bonus}. The amount shows as earned for {days} days and is paid out once you have at least {amount} available.
faq.taxQ: Do I have to pay tax?
faq.taxA: Yes. Without a CVR number it is B-income, which we report to the Danish Tax Agency (Skattestyrelsen) – you pay the tax yourself via your preliminary income assessment. With a CVR number, you get a settlement statement.
faq.ageA: Yes, from the age of {age}. A parent must approve the agreement by email before we pay out. You can still share your link in the meantime.
faq.rulesQ: What am I not allowed to do?
faq.rulesA: You must always state that it is advertising and that you receive a bonus. No mass emails or text messages to people you don't know, and never use AI to call people.
